items.title: Improve loading screen text contrast.
items.what: Screenshot 1 shows the 'SM KARATE KIDS' and 'ASMONGOLD VS HASANABI' text on the loading screen is very dark gray against a black background. The text is barely legible.
items.why: Poor contrast makes the loading screen feel unfinished and can frustrate players who are unsure if the game is actually loading. It's the first impression.
items.how: Increase the text color's lightness to a near-white shade (e.g., #D0D0D0) to significantly improve readability.

items.title: Improve fighter placement and framing.
items.what: Screenshots 2, 5, and 8 show the fighters positioned low in the frame, leaving a large expanse of empty mat below them. The vertical space feels wasted.
items.why: This composition feels unbalanced and doesn't make the most of the screen real estate. It makes the fighters look small and insignificant.
items.how: Adjust the camera position or fighter placement to center them vertically in the frame, filling more of the screen and creating a more dynamic composition.  Consider a slight upward angle to emphasize the fighters' power.

items.title: Reduce control overlap with the edge of the screen.
items.what: Screenshots 2, 3, 4, 5, 8, 9, and 10 show the left and right control sticks are very close to the edges of the screen.  On a phone, accidental touches are likely.
items.why: Accidental touches will disrupt gameplay and frustrate players.  The close proximity makes the controls feel cramped.
items.how: Increase the padding around the control sticks by at least 15-20 pixels on all sides. This provides a larger margin for error and makes the controls easier to use.

items.title: Improve readability of the technique list.
items.what: Screenshot 6 shows the technique list is densely packed with text, making it difficult to scan and understand quickly. The font size and line spacing are too small.
items.why: Players need to quickly find and understand the available techniques. A cluttered list hinders this process, making the game feel less accessible.
items.how: Increase the font size by 1-2 points and add more vertical spacing between list items. Consider using a slightly bolder font weight for improved clarity.

items.title: Clarify the 'Show performance HUD' toggle.
items.what: Screenshot 7 shows the 'Show performance HUD' toggle in the settings menu. The description 'Career — played 0 · won 0 · best time —' is unclear and confusing.
items.why: Players won't understand what this toggle does, and it might be accidentally enabled or disabled.  Ambiguous settings create a poor user experience.
items.how: Replace the confusing description with a clear explanation like 'Show frame rate and memory usage' or 'Display performance metrics.'
